qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project research scientist i (non-medical): Ph.D. in Chemistry/ Biological/ Pharmaceutical Sciences.

salary_details.details: The fellowship is offered on a consolidated basis with 30% HRA per month as specified in the official notification.

important_instructions: The duration of the project is three (03) months, extendable for one (01) year. Interested candidates should appear directly for the walk-in interview at the specified venue and time. Candidates must bring Class 10th, 12th, Graduate, Postgraduate, and Ph.D. Degree Certificates. Candidates must bring a certificate of experience. For any queries, candidates may contact the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available under this notification.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 at 03.00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Chemistry, Biological, or Pharmaceutical Sciences.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly fellowship for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship of Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurgaon Expressway, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, Faridabad-121001, Haryana.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring Class 10th, 12th, Graduate, Postgraduate, and Ph.D. Degree Certificates along with a certificate of experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the project?
faq.answer: The project duration is three (03) months, which is extendable for one (01) year.
